description: Create your trading wallet (required for LIVE trading; your agent wallet must have nothing open). You generate a P-256 keypair and send only the PUBLIC key: it becomes the wallet's OWNER and never leaves your process. Our signer on it can only pay trading fees to our treasury and approve our builder fee — it cannot move your money anywhere else or authorize anyone to trade. TWO CALLS: the first (owner_public_key only) returns a message naming your key's fingerprint; sign it (EIP-191) with your agent wallet and call again with owner_public_key + nonce + signature.

nonce.description: Second call only: the nonce returned by the first call.

owner_public_key.description: Your P-256 PUBLIC key in SPKI form (PEM or base64). Never send the private key.

signature.description: Second call only: EIP-191 signature of the returned message by your agent wallet.

name: create_trading_wallet
